question: What does the College English / writing requirement look like for freshmen? Is there a required composition course, and what is its course number?
answer:
For first-year students, required courses depend on placement: incoming first-year students are prepackaged into appropriate courses as available. Students needing developmental reading/writing should take CRWT 080 or 090, CRWT 101, and/or developmental math in their first semester. These requirements should be completed by 64 credits; Banner blocks registration until the required courses are scheduled, and continues blocking until Critical Reading and Writing II and general education mathematics are successfully completed. [7][8]
The required General Education Critical Reading & Writing course is CRWT 102. [10] Placement information includes CRWT 101 as the first credit-bearing course in the progression, CRWT 101S with an extra weekly support class, and CRWT 102. An SAT-Evidence-Based Reading & Writing score of 620 or higher places students in CRWT 102. [10][11]

note_A: Matches the catalog Reading/Writing/Math section (prepackaging, CRWT 080/090/101 in the first semester, the 64-credit deadline, Banner blocks until CRWT II and Gen Ed math are completed) and the testing pages (CRWT 101, 101S, CRWT 102 meets the Gen Ed requirement, SAT EBRW 620+ places into CRWT 102).
note_B: The catalog Gen Ed Reading/Writing/Math section supports CRWT 080/090 and 101 in the first semester, prepackaging, the 64-credit rule and the Banner blocks. The post-testing page describes CRWT 101, 101S (extra weekly meeting) and CRWT 102 as the required Gen Ed course, and reading-placement says SAT EBRW 620+ places into CRWT 102.

question: My son is undecided. In your opinion, should he major in economics or finance if he wants a good job after graduating?
answer:

question: Does Ramapo offer a major in environmental science, and if so, what are the core courses required and how many credits is the major itself?
